exodus.5.p1.b1.text: After that, Moses and Aaron went to Pharaoh and said,

exodus.5.p1.b2.text: This is what the LORD, the God of Israel, says: ‘Let My people go, so that they may hold a feast to Me in the wilderness.’

exodus.5.p1.b3.text: Who is the LORD that I should obey His voice and let Israel go? I do not know the LORD, and I will not let Israel go.

exodus.5.p2.b4.text: … Please let us go on a three-day journey into the wilderness to sacrifice to the LORD our God, or He may strike us with plagues or with the sword.

exodus.5.p2.b5.text: Moses and Aaron, why do you draw the people away from their work? Get back to your labor!

exodus.5.p2.b6.text: You shall no longer supply the people with straw for making bricks. They must go and gather their own straw.

exodus.5.p2.b7.text: But require of them the same quota of bricks as before; do not reduce it. …

exodus.5.p3.b8.text: This is what Pharaoh says: ‘I am no longer giving you straw. Go and get your own straw wherever you can find it; but your workload will in no way be reduced.’

exodus.5.p3.b9.text: So the people scattered all over the land of Egypt to gather stubble for straw.

exodus.5.p3.b10.text: Fulfill your quota each day, just as you did when straw was provided.

exodus.5.p3.b11.text: Why have you not fulfilled your quota of bricks yesterday or today, as you did before?

exodus.5.p4.b12.text: So the Israelite foremen went and appealed to Pharaoh …

exodus.5.p4.b13.text: Why are you treating your servants this way? … Look, your servants are being beaten, but the fault is with your own people.

exodus.5.p4.b15.text: Now get to work. You will be given no straw, yet you must deliver the full quota of bricks.

exodus.5.p5.b16.text: The Israelite foremen realized they were in trouble …

exodus.5.p5.b17.text: When they left Pharaoh, they confronted Moses and Aaron, who stood waiting to meet them.

exodus.5.p5.b18.text: May the LORD look upon you and judge you, … for you have made us a stench before Pharaoh and his officials; you have placed in their hand a sword to kill us!

exodus.5.p6.b19.text: So Moses returned to the LORD and asked,

exodus.5.p6.b20.text: Lord, why have You brought trouble upon this people? Is this why You sent me?

exodus.5.p6.b21.text: Ever since I went to Pharaoh to speak in Your name, he has brought trouble on this people, and You have not delivered Your people in any way.
